stray_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Walk Together
stray_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] The road is long and crowded.
Stay near your parents.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Honor the Feast
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Passover is the holy memory of God.
You must go.

Go where wisdom is spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Enter and listen to the teachers

[TODO:ja] The pilgrims begin to depart.
The teachers still speak of God.

follow_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] The Father's house holds you.
You are meant to remain.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Stay to hear the words of God

search.text:
[TODO:ja] Three days pass in the temple.
Mary and Joseph walk Jerusalem in fear.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Slip away and hide from them
[TODO:ja] Remain where they will find you

flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] They love you and seek you.
Wait where you belong.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Remain where they will find you

teachers.title: [TODO:ja] Among the Wise
teachers.text:
[TODO:ja] The elders ask many questions.
They wait for your answer.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Speak Gently
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Truth lives within you.
Let it be heard.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Your soft voice fills the room.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Be Humble
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Wisdom is not for boasting.
Speak with quiet grace.

reunion.title: [TODO:ja] Mary Finds You
reunion.text:
[TODO:ja] She weeps:
"Why have you done this to us?"

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] She holds the words in her heart.
[TODO:ja] Do not run from her love.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Speak with Love
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] She is your mother.
Answer her with grace.

shame_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Stay With Her
shame_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] She has searched three days.
Give her the truth.

return.title: [TODO:ja] Home to Nazareth
return.text:
[TODO:ja] You walk with them under the dawn.
You grow in wisdom and grace.
